slides.title: A shared drive is [not brand management].
slides.lede: A brand is governed when people know what they may change, what needs approval, and where the current approved version lives.

cards.label: Over-centralised
cards.text: Queues, missed opportunities and work produced off-system.

cards.label: Over-devolved
cards.text: Duplicated assets, competing sub-brands and inconsistent positioning.

items.title: Central team
items.text: Owns positioning, identity, messaging and templates.

items.title: Local teams
items.text: Execute within boundaries and add local proof.

items.title: Governance council
items.text: Decides exceptions across regions and service lines.

items.title: Specialist reviewers
items.text: Join only when content triggers a risk.

slides.title: Every controlled asset needs [a status]
slides.note: A logo may be stable for years. **A financial claim may need review in months.**

slides.title: A recurring exception is a [missing rule]
slides.text: Make exceptions visible, time-bound and reviewable. If the same request keeps coming back, turn it into a standard capability or revise the rule.

slides.quote: Begin with a decision-rights audit, not a software purchase.
slides.text: Name the owners of your riskiest assets first. The right portal becomes far easier to choose.

slides.title: Protect what builds equity. [Free teams] to act.
slides.lede: Centralised brand management vs devolved brand control. Read the full guide via the link in our bio.
